reviews.text:
Helen at Happy Stays- small dog boarding.
If I could give 100 stars I would. She is incredible.
After a previous experience in Kelowna, I have been quite nervous leaving my Chihuahua so this was my first time using boarding.

Helen stands out with her calm, welcoming and diligent nature. Safety is her primary concern.

My Chihuahua usually does not warm up to anyone but with Helen, zero issues! She settled in quickly and got along very well with the fabulous group of little dogs she had there.
Helen puts a great amount of effort into insuring each individual animals needs are met. The daily walks, making sure they are happy, comfortable, safe and delivering updates through the day.
I last minute needed to extend my stay for one more night and she accommodated me without issue.

Truly a stress free experience for myself and my dog. I am incredibly lucky to have found Happy Stays and would HIGHLY recommend it to anyone seeking a small dog boarding that goes above and beyond.

We had a great experience with Happy Stays! Helen was wonderful and kept us updated with pictures of our dog, Felfel, which really gave us peace of mind. From the first time I met Helen, I immediately felt comfortable leaving Felfel with her. She was caring and friendly.
I think Felfel had a great time and came home happy! We would definitely recommend Happy Stays and Helen. 🐶❤️
So happy we found Helen to board our pup. We had no anxiety knowing she was in such good hands. We got regular photos and updates and could see she was doing great with Helen and the other dogs.

An absolute 5-star home away from home! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We have been boarding our Bichon Shih Tzu, Winston, with Helen about 5 times a year for the past 6 years, and we truly cannot recommend her highly enough.
Dropping Winston off with Helen and her two grown-up kids doesn't feel like leaving him at a boarder—it feels exactly like sending him off to summer camp to hang out with all his besties!
The level of personal care Winston receives is unmatched. Helen and her family go above and beyond, taking the dogs out for fun walks and/or exciting field trips every single day. I get total peace of mind while away because Helen sends multiple photos and videos daily, capturing just how happy and engaged he is.
To top it all off, Helen treats Winston like pure royalty—even letting him sleep in bed with her at night. The warmth, love, and dedication this family pours into their furry guests is incredible. Winston absolutely adores them, and we are so grateful to have found such a safe, loving environment for our sweet boy!

Our dog Timon has been going to Happy Stays for more than a year and we only have fantastic things to say about Helen and team! They provide love and care for him as if one of their own, and Timon is always excited to be dropped off! We are beyond grateful to have found Happy Stays.

This was the first time leaving my 1yr Chihuahua and first time using Happy Stays and honestly, I was beyond impressed. My little Chi was extremely well cared for with lots attention , other small dog playmates and LOTS of walks which she loved. I received daily pics/videos which clearly showed how much fun she was having at “doggie camp”. I really think she had more fun on her vacation than I did!  I would not hesitate to use Happy Stays again and highly recommended them!  It’s hard to find a place to leave your dog, particularly when they are small, where you feel secure and comfortable. Happy Stays is all that and more. Thanks for taking such wonderful care of my fur-baby 💜

Margot is a rescued toy-poodle with an anxious disposition. She's been with me for 7 years but still needs a little extra grace when adjusting to new people and new routines.

Happy Stays is 100% the perfect solution for someone like me whose small dog has separation anxiety and needs to feel safe. From the initial "interview" visit, everything was handled professionally with utmost care. Helen has it completely covered and I always know that I can leave Margot in her (and her family's) capable hands.

I hugely appreciate that the riverfront park space (dog heaven), where the little munchkins get to explore, is literally right across the street and the update photos of the "buddies hanging out at sleepaway camp" confirms that they're living it up with supervision.

Margot enjoys the company of people slightly more than dogs, but with Helen she's getting the best of both worlds. I never worry at all while I'm away and I'm always glad that everything is under control.

We were so happy with Happy Stays Small-Dog Boarding!!  Helen was so great with daily updates on our Jagger and pictures of their daily walks.  We will be using Happy Stays for sure on our next vacation.

Helen is absolutely amazing! Every time we leave our dog in her care, we know she’s getting the best possible treatment. I would 100% recommend Helen to anyone looking for someone they can truly trust with their pet. I feel so much more comfortable traveling knowing that I’ll receive plenty of updates and pictures along the way. It gives me such peace of mind knowing my dog is happy, safe, and so well cared for!

We are beyond Happy with Happy Stays Small-Dog Boarding!  It was a relief when we found Helen to watch over Dory for 1 month.  Helen's communication, home, walks, and updates are 5 star!  Everyday, Helen would update us via WhatsApp with Dory's activities.  It is clear Dory was very well loved. We have already signed Dory up again with Helen.
Lenny loves coming here, and I love getting all the photo updates. He instantly forgets about me when he gets out of the car

It has taken us 7 years to find someone to look after Juniper, and be understanding of his boundaries. He really enjoys being with Helen and the other dogs - I can go away and know that he’s in good hands.
Our pet was in the best hands during our trip. She was very well taken care of. We had constant updates with pictures. Will definitely chose them again. Totally recommended!!!
Legal business? Property Management rules here don't allow multiple pets. What else are they breaking?

We had the pleasure of having our Shih-Tzu, Butter, stay with Helen while we were away. Even during our initial meet and greet, Butter was very comfortable and found himself right at home. Butter gets excited when he meets other humans and especially dogs, but with Helen he was calm and happy. He loved being on Helen’s lap and has lots of fun with the pack, and going through all the toys during his stay. We also really appreciate the frequent updates and pictures from Helen. He slept long hours after coming home to recover from his great vacation. Thank you again Helen for taking good care of Butter!

We used to use regular boarding kennels, which was fine when my dog was younger. But now that he's 14, he has some difficulty walking and tends to get more anxious when he's alone or in unfamiliar places. We're so glad we found Helen! It gives us peace of mind to know we can go out of town, and he's comfortable in a home with personalized care, with Helen giving us regular updates with photos so we know what he's up to! He loves the walks (and being carried when he's too tired), trying out all the dog beds in the house, and just chilling outside in her patio!

We were initially quite nervous about leaving our rescue dog, Millie, with a sitter. However, from the very moment we met Helen, all our worries disappeared. She made us feel completely at ease with her calm, kind demeanor and her clear love for animals. It was obvious that she has a genuine passion for caring for dogs, and we knew Millie would be in great hands. Throughout Millie's stay, Helen went above and beyond to keep us updated with daily photos and messages. It was such a relief to see how happy and relaxed Millie was. She absolutely loved spending time with the other dogs at Helen's place and had plenty of new friends to play with. We could tell that Millie was not only well cared for but genuinely enjoying her time there. Helen took care of everything ensuring Millie felt comfortable, fed, and entertained, while also giving her the personal attention she needs. It was clear Millie was happy, content, and loved during her stay. We can’t thank Helen enough for providing such a safe, fun, and loving environment. We will definitely be sending Millie back to Happy Stays the next time we need a sitter. It’s such a relief to know that we can leave her in such capable hands, and we highly recommend Helen to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring dog sitter. Thank you again, Helen, for making Millie’s stay so wonderful!

Helen did such an amazing job taking care of our baby. She sent constant updates everyday and I trust her wholeheartedly! Our little boy seemed so happy and was truly well taken care of. We definitely will be having Pablo stay with Helen again! Thank you, Helen :)

From start to finish, our experience with Helen of Happy Stays was excellent. We appreciated her calm nature, love for dogs, and communication throughout. Helen kept us updated with regular texts, photos, and videos which was comforting to see how much fun they were having. I wholeheartedly recommend Happy Stays to anyone in need of a reliable and loving dog sitter. Helen made our time away from Gigi stress-free, knowing that our fur baby was in the best possible hands. Thank you, Helen, for your outstanding service and for being such a wonderful caregiver to Gigi!

Tilley had a great time staying with Helen! I appreciated the detailed updates and all the photos. Helen was super flexible with drop off and pick up, even with my flight coming back delayed. Helen was also very patient with Tilley’s quirks - she can be a funny eater and a very slow walker. I would happily have Tilley stay with Helen again!

I highly recommend Happy stays to anyone looking for reliable and loving care for their furry friend. It’s a huge relief knowing my dog is in such good hands while I’m away!  I especially appreciate the updates I receive during the day, whether it’s photos or a quick text, letting me know how my dog is doing.  My dog always comes home happy, tired, and content—signs of a great experience! It’s clear that Helen truly cares about the dogs and is dedicated to making sure they have a safe, enjoyable time.

Your in safe hands with Helen at Happy Stays! Helen took great care of our two pugs and provided honest feedback and daily updates, during what can be a very traumatic time for our pets while they’re away from there owners. I highly recommend Helen at Happy Stays for a safe and secure home while you’re away from your special pet.

Helen took wonderful care of my pup and always kept me updated with photos and messages. I highly recommend Happy Stays. Such a cozy environment and a warm, welcoming home. Thank you, Helen and family : )
10/10! Felt safe leaving my pup

Helen was very kind and professional to deal with when boarding my mother’s dog. She always makes sure your dog is a good fit for her home and has a little questionnaire where you can explain anything specific for your pet. …

We couldn't have been luckier than we were to stumble across Helen when we did. Not only was she gracious enough to let our little puppy stay with her while we were away, but she cared for him as if he was her own. The constant updates and …
Helen is very attentive to all the dogs in her care. Highly recommended to anyone in Vancouver!

Booking our beloved Poco into HappyStays for a two-month stay was the best decision we could have made for our extended travels. Every day, Helen sent us pictures and updates, which became something we looked forward to. Through these daily …
